structure: Main prediction first: the storm will reach the party very soon.
Evidence: point to the clues (dark clouds, rain, lightning, wind blowing balloons and napkins).
Predict what 3–4 people will do (will probably / is going to / might).
Final outcome: how the situation will most likely end.
modelAnswer: Looking at this picture, I think the party is about to be interrupted by a storm. On the left, dark clouds are rolling in, and you can already see rain and even lightning just behind the fence. The wind is picking up, too, because the balloons are blowing sideways and a couple of napkins are flying off the table. So I'd say it'll start pouring in the next few minutes. The woman in the green dress, who's pointing at the sky, will probably tell everyone to go inside. The dad at the barbecue will have to grab the food off the grill, and the two boys on the lawn will run in through the open back door. As for the birthday girl, she'll have to blow out her candles quickly, or the wind will do it for her! Someone will carry the cake inside, and the dog, which is already hiding under the table, won't need to be asked twice. In the end, they'll just move the party indoors.

usefulExpressions.usageVi: Đưa ra dự đoán chính kèm khung thời gian
Thay đổi mức độ chắc chắn khi dự đoán hành động của từng người
Còn về… — chuyển sang nhân vật khác mượt mà
Kết luận cách tình huống sẽ kết thúc

commonMistakes: Chỉ mô tả bức tranh như Task 3 mà quên dự đoán; Task 4 phải dùng nhiều 'will / is going to / might'.
Đưa ra dự đoán không có căn cứ trong tranh (ví dụ 'they will call the police'); hãy luôn chỉ ra manh mối như mây đen, gió.
Dùng sai 'will' với động từ chia: 'it will starts' → 'it will start'.
